title: xte W3: refuse a cloud run whose FINAL resolved runner is not pi on GLM, after tier overlays
body: Parent xte. internal/profile/profile.go route applies the tier overlay after the cloud overlay and never re-checks. This repo's own runners.toml [roles.implement.tiers.balanced] kind=codex would route codex in the container under cloud, and a cloud cell without kind inherits the role's claude (findings dd60e88c, ea1a62d3). Check the resolved runner/model at construction under cloud, and require the cloud cell to state kind and model.
